text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear claim that driverless cars are \"such a great idea\"","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states a direct position early so the reader immediately knows what it is arguing."},{"evidence":"\"not only becuase... but becuase...\" and later \"However\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay uses a more recognizable argumentative structure by moving from support to counterpoint and back to a conclusion."},{"evidence":"\"They have sensors to tell you when something ahead requires attention\" and \"the car watches the driver\"","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay uses specific details from the article to back up its claims instead of relying mostly on general statements."},{"evidence":"\"However their is a lot of negative things... what if a car fails...\"","quality":"counterargument","description":"The essay acknowledges a downside from the article, which makes the argument feel more balanced and developed."},{"evidence":"\"I think this idea on the cars should be considered for the future\"","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends by restating its position in a closing sentence rather than just trailing off."}]}
